• It is software that acts as an interface between the end-user and computer hardware.
 
• Every computer must have at least one OS to run other programs.

• It refers to the files and programs that make up the computer's operating system.

questions.question: Which of the following species is also called the 'Kashmir Deer'?
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is ‘Hangul’**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hangul (Kashmir Deer):**

 
 
• Hangul, also known as the **Kashmir Deer**, is the state animal of Jammu & Kashmir.
 
• It is primarily found in the **Dachigam National Park**, located near Srinagar.
 
• The species is listed as **Critically Endangered** on the IUCN Red List due to rapidly declining populations.
 
• It is protected under **Schedule I** of the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972, which ensures the highest degree of protection.
 
• Its population has drastically declined over decades due to habitat loss, poaching, and human interference.
 
• **Ex-situ conservation** efforts are being carried out in the forested areas of **Shikargah Tral** in South Kashmir.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Barasingha:**

 
 
• Also called the **Swamp Deer**, known for its distinctive multi-tined antlers.
 
• Mainly found in **Kanha National Park** of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It prefers swampy grasslands, unlike Hangul which is a mountain species.
 
 
 
• **Sangai:**
 
 
• Also known as the **Dancing Deer**, found in the floating biomass (phumdis) of **Keibul Lamjao National Park** in Manipur.
 
• It is one of the rarest deer species in the world and has a unique gait due to its wetland habitat.
 
 
 
• **Cheetal:**
 
 
• Commonly known as the **Spotted Deer** or **Axis Deer**.
 
• Widespread across the Indian subcontinent and commonly seen in many national parks.
 
• Unlike Hangul, it is not an endangered species and has a stable population.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The Hangul population, once estimated at over 5,000 in the early 1900s, has fallen to **less than 200** today.
 
• Major threats include **habitat fragmentation, livestock grazing, poaching,** and political disturbances in the region.
 
• Conservation programs like the **Project Hangul** aim to restore and protect the species.

questions.question: Which mountain range is the primary focus of the Green Aravalli Action Plan?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Aravalli Range.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Green Aravalli Action Plan** is specifically designed for the **conservation and restoration of the Aravalli Range**.
 
• The Aravalli range is one of the **oldest fold mountain systems in the world** and holds immense ecological significance.
 
• The plan focuses on increasing **green cover, biodiversity conservation, and ecological restoration** in the Aravalli region.
 
• The Aravallis play a crucial role in **groundwater recharge and climate regulation**, particularly in north-western India.
 
• The initiative aims to curb **land degradation, deforestation, and desertification** affecting the Aravalli landscape.
 
• Conservation of the Aravalli range is considered vital for maintaining **environmental balance in the Delhi-NCR region**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vindhya Range**

 
 
• The Vindhya Range is located in central India and acts as a natural divide between northern and southern India.
 
• It is primarily composed of sedimentary rocks.
 
• The range influences the drainage pattern of rivers such as the Narmada and Son.
 
• The Vindhyas are not the focus of the Green Aravalli Action Plan.
 
• Environmental initiatives in the Vindhya region are generally addressed under regional forest and wildlife programmes.
 
 
 
• **Satpura Range**
 
 
• The Satpura Range lies south of the Vindhya range in central India.
 
• It is known for dense forests and rich biodiversity.
 
• The Satpuras support important protected areas such as national parks and wildlife sanctuaries.
 
• Conservation efforts here are often linked with tiger reserves and forest conservation programmes.
 
• The Satpura range is not part of the Aravalli conservation framework.
 
 
 
• **Western Ghats**
 
 
• The Western Ghats run parallel to the western coast of India and are recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• They are one of the world’s biodiversity hotspots.
 
• The Western Ghats play a major role in influencing the Indian monsoon system.
 
• Conservation initiatives here focus on rainforests, endemic species, and watershed protection.
 
• The Western Ghats are not covered under the Green Aravalli Action Plan.

questions.question: The 16th Finance Commission (FC-16) has defined "Income Distance" based on which of the following calculations?

options.text: The difference between a state’s per capita GSDP and the state with the highest per capita GSDP.
The difference between a state’s per capita GSDP and the average per capita GSDP of all states.
The difference between a state’s per capita GSDP and the national average GDP per capita.
The difference between a state’s per capita GSDP and the average per capita GSDP of the top three large states with the highest per capita GSDP.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The difference between a state’s per capita GSDP and the average per capita GSDP of the top three large states with the highest per capita GSDP.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 16th Finance Commission (FC-16) introduced a refined definition for 'Income Distance' to determine horizontal devolution for 2026-31.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Income distance is now calculated as the gap between a state's per capita GSDP and the average of the top three large states with the highest per capita GSDP.**
 
• The Per capita GSDP is computed as the average over the period 2018-19 to 2023-24.
 
• To ensure data accuracy and fairness, the pandemic year of 2020-21 has been excluded from this average calculation.
 
• States with a lower per capita GSDP receive a higher share under this parameter to promote fiscal equity across the country.
 
• Income Distance Statistics:__
 __
 
• Weightage in FC-16 - 42.5%
 
• Calculation Period - 2018-19 to 2023-24 (Excluding 2020-21)
 
• Benchmark - Average of top 3 large states
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• GSDP (Gross State Domestic Product)__

 __
 
• It represents the total value of all finished goods and services produced within a state's borders during a specific period.
 
 
 
• Equity vs. Efficiency__
 __
 
• Income Distance is an 'equity' parameter (helping poorer states), while the new 'Contribution to GDP' is an 'efficiency' parameter (rewarding productive states).
 
 
 
• 15th FC Comparison__
 __
 
• The 15th FC typically used the distance from the single highest-income state, whereas the 16th FC uses an average of the top three to create a more stable benchmark.
 
 
 
• Horizontal Devolution__
 
 
• The allocation of the 41% tax pool among states based on the formula containing Income Distance, Population, Area, etc.

questions.question: Which among the following sectors of the Economy has seen a maximum rise since economic reforms in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the **Tertiary Sector. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• India has seen the highest growth in the tertiary or services sector after economic reforms compared to other services.
 
• Economic reform is a process that involves fundamental changes in the basic features of the economy. This is the change from control to liberalization. The role of the states here will not be to control and prevent but as facilitators, collaborators, promoters and observers.
 
• While Rajiv Gandhi launched a new economic policy in 1985, the task of accelerating this liberal policy was undertaken by the then Prime Minister Narasimha Rao and Finance Minister Dr Manmohan Singh introduced new economic reforms in 1991.
 
• Sectors are classified as private sector, government sector and joint sector on the basis of ownership and management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the nature of enterprises, various productive enterprises are classified into three sectors of the economy. These are : 
 
• **The primary sector** is also called the agricultural sector.
 
 
• Businesses based mainly on natural resources are included in the primary sector. E.g. Activities like agriculture and animal husbandry, poultry, fisheries, jungle business, and mining.
 
• In a developing economy like India, more than half of the population is engaged in the primary sector.

Control over these islands also has implications for regional military power and access to important shipping routes.

questions.question: There is a wooden cube with an edge length of 14 cm. A hemisphere with a radius of 7 cm is carved out from each face of the cube. Find the surface area (in cm²) of the remaining structure. (Usepi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Each hemispherical carving removes a circle (πr²) but adds a curved surface (2πr²).

Net surface area gain per face = 2πr² − πr² = +πr².

Total surface area = 6 × (Side² + πr²).

Total surface area = 6 × (14² + (22/7) × 7²).

Total surface area = 6 × (196 + 154) = 6 × 350 = 2100 cm².

**∴ Answer = 2100**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Edge length of wooden cube (a) = 14 cm

Radius of hemisphere (r) = 7 cm

Number of faces = 6

**Formula used:**

Total Surface Area = TSA of Cube − 6 × (Area of Circle) + 6 × (CSA of Hemisphere)

Surface Area = 6a² + 6πr²

 
 
 
 
 Edge (a) = 14 cm r = 7 cm Hemisphere carved from each face 

**Calculations:**

Total Surface Area of the cube = 6 × 14²

⇒ 6 × 196 = 1176 cm²

⇒ Surface area removed from 6 faces = 6 × πr² = 6 × (22/7) × 7 × 7 = 924 cm²

⇒ Surface area added by 6 hemispherical cavities = 6 × 2πr² = 6 × 2 × (22/7) × 7 × 7 = 1848 cm²

⇒ Net Surface Area = 1176 − 924 + 1848

⇒ Net Surface Area = 1176 + 924 = 2100 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 2100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cube

The total surface area of a cube with edge 'a' is 6a². The lateral surface area is 4a².

Hemisphere Formulas

For a hemisphere of radius 'r', Curved Surface Area = 2πr² and Volume = (2/3)πr³.

Surface Area Change during Carving

When a hemisphere is carved out from a solid, the total surface area increases by the difference between the curved surface added and the base area removed (πr²).

Volume of Remaining Structure

The volume of the remaining structure is the original volume of the cube (a³) minus the volume of all carved shapes (6 × 2/3πr³).

questions.question: The length of each side of a rhombus is 17 cm and one of the diagonals is 30 cm. What is the area of the rhombus?

Side = 17 cm, Half-diagonal (d₁/2) = 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm.

Using Pythagorean triplet (8, 15, 17), the other half-diagonal = 8 cm.

Full second diagonal (d₂) = 8 × 2 = 16 cm.

Area of rhombus = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂ = (1/2) × 30 × 16.

Area = 15 × 16 = 240 cm².

**∴ Answer = 240 cm²**

**Given:**

Side (s) = 17 cm, One diagonal (d₁) = 30 cm

**Formula used:**

In a rhombus, s² = (d₁/2)² + (d₂/2)²

Area = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂

 
 
• 
• Side = 17 15 15 8 8 Area = 1/2 × 30 × 16 = 240 cm²

**Calculations:**

Length of half of the given diagonal = 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm

⇒ Let the other half-diagonal be x.

⇒ 17² = 15² + x²

⇒ 289 = 225 + x²

⇒ x² = 289 − 225 = 64

⇒ x = √64 = 8 cm

⇒ Full second diagonal (d₂) = 8 × 2 = 16 cm

⇒ Area = (1/2) × 30 × 16

⇒ Area = 15 × 16 = 240 cm²

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the option elimination method by substituting the values into the simplest equation: y − z = 6.

Option 1: −17/4 − 7/4 = −24/4 = −6 (Incorrect)

Option 2: 55/4 − (−17/4) = 72/4 = 18 (Incorrect)

Option 3: 7/4 − (−17/4) = 24/4 = 6 (Correct)

Now verify x by substituting y and z from Option 3 into Equation 1: 2x + 7/4 − 17/4 = 25

⇒ 2x − 10/4 = 25 ⇒ 2x = 25 + 2.5 = 27.5 ⇒ x = 13.75 or 55/4.

**∴ Answer = (3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Eq (1): 2x + y + z = 25

Eq (2): x − 3y + 2z = 0

Eq (3): y − z = 6

**Formula used:**

Method of substitution: Express one variable in terms of others and substitute to solve.

 Step 1: From Eq (3), y = z + 6 
• Step 2: Sub y in (1) to get x in terms of z 
• Step 3: Sub x, y in (2) to find z 

**Calculations:**

From Eq (3): y = z + 6

Substitute y in Eq (1):

⇒ 2x + (z + 6) + z = 25

⇒ 2x + 2z = 19 ⇒ x = (19 − 2z) / 2

Substitute x and y in Eq (2):

⇒ [(19 − 2z) / 2] − 3(z + 6) + 2z = 0

⇒ (19 − 2z) − 6(z + 6) + 4z = 0 (Multiplying by 2)

⇒ 19 − 2z − 6z − 36 + 4z = 0 ⇒ −4z − 17 = 0 ⇒ z = −17/4

⇒ y = −17/4 + 6 = 7/4

⇒ x = (19 − 2(−17/4)) / 2 = (19 + 17/2) / 2 = (55/2) / 2 = 55/4

**∴ The correct answer is (3).**

A method using determinants where x = Dₓ/D, y = Dy/D, z = Dz/D, provided the main determinant D ≠ 0.

A system is consistent if it has at least one solution. If the determinant of coefficients is non-zero, it has a unique solution.

Adding or subtracting equations to eliminate one variable at a time until a single variable remains.

questions.question: A boat covers a certain distance downstream in 6 hours and takes 8 hours to return upstream to the starting point. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let boat speed = x

Downstream speed = x + 4, Upstream speed = x − 4

Same distance ⇒ ratio of speeds = inverse of time

⇒ (x + 4) : (x − 4) = 8 : 6 = 4 : 3

⇒ 3(x + 4) = 4(x − 4)

⇒ 3x + 12 = 4x − 16 ⇒ x = 28

**∴ Answer = 28 km/h**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Downstream time = 6 hr, Upstream time = 8 hr

Speed of stream = 4 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let distance = D

⇒ Downstream speed = D ÷ 6

⇒ Upstream speed = D ÷ 8

⇒ Boat speed = (Downstream + Upstream) ÷ 2

⇒ = (D/6 + D/8) ÷ 2

⇒ = (4D + 3D) ÷ 24 × 1/2

⇒ = 7D ÷ 48

⇒ Stream speed = (Downstream − Upstream) ÷ 2

⇒ 4 = (D/6 − D/8) ÷ 2

⇒ 4 = (4D − 3D) ÷ 24 × 1/2

⇒ 4 = D ÷ 48

⇒ D = 192

⇒ Boat speed = 7D ÷ 48 = 7 × 192 ÷ 48 = 28 km/hr

**∴ Final Answer = 28 km/h**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Boat Formula:** Boat speed = (Downstream + Upstream) ÷ 2

**Stream Formula:** Stream speed = (Downstream − Upstream) ÷ 2

**Exam Insight:** Use ratio method when time is given for same distance

⇒ 2,90,000 × 1.1 = 3,19,000

questions.question: By selling an article at (3)/(11) of its marked price, Hitesh incurs a loss of 15%. If he sells it at 54% of its marked price, then the profit percentage is

Use 100 base:

⇒ Loss 15% ⇒ CP = 100, SP = 85

⇒ SP = 3/11 MP ⇒ 85 = 3/11 MP ⇒ MP = (85 × 11) ÷ 3

⇒ New SP = 54% MP = 0.54 × (85 × 11 ÷ 3)

⇒ SP = 168.3, CP = 100

⇒ Profit = 68.3%

**∴ Answer ≈ 68.3%**

SP = (3 ÷ 11) MP

Loss = 15%

Loss% = [(CP − SP) ÷ CP] × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let MP = 11

⇒ SP = 3

⇒ Loss = 15%

⇒ SP = 85% of CP

⇒ 3 = 0.85 CP

⇒ CP = 3 ÷ 0.85 = 60 ÷ 17

⇒ New SP = 54% of MP

⇒ Profit% = [(SP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100

questions.question: A train of length 120 m travelling at 60 km/hr crosses another train travelling in the same direction at 24 km/hr in 30 seconds. What is the length (in m) of another train?

Relative speed (same direction) = 60 − 24 = 36 km/hr

Relative speed in m/s = 36 × (5/18) = 10 m/s

Total distance (Sum of lengths) = Relative speed × Time = 10 × 30 = 300 m

Length of another train = Total distance − Length of first train = 300 − 120 = 180 m

**∴ Answer = 180**

Speed of first train (S₁) = 60 km/hr

Speed of second train (S₂) = 24 km/hr

Time taken to cross (T) = 30 seconds

**Formula used:**

Total Distance = Relative Speed × Time

Relative Speed (Same direction) = S₁ − S₂

 Train 1 (120 m) 60 km/hr 
• Train 2 (L2 = ?) 24 km/hr 
• 
• Total Relative Distance = 300 m 
 

**Calculations:**

Relative Speed = 60 − 24 = 36 km/hr

⇒ Relative Speed in m/s = 36 × (5/18) = 10 m/s

⇒ Total Distance = L₁ + L₂ = Relative Speed × Time

⇒ 120 + L₂ = 10 × 30

⇒ 120 + L₂ = 300

⇒ L₂ = 300 − 120

⇒ L₂ = 180 m

**∴ The correct answer is 180 (Option 3).**

questions.question: If 5³x ⁺ ⁴ = (5 ⁴)¹⁰⁵ , then find the integral part of x.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Compare the exponents on both sides of base 5.

Exponent on RHS = 4 × 105 = 420.

Equate with LHS exponent: 3x + 4 = 420.

3x = 416 → x = 138.66...

The integral part is the value before the decimal.

**∴ Answer = 138**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Equation: 5³x ⁺ ⁴ = (5⁴)¹⁰⁵

**Formula used:**

(am)ⁿ = am × ⁿ

If ap = aq, then p = q (where a > 0, a ≠ 1)

 LHS 5³x ⁺ ⁴ = RHS (5⁴)¹⁰⁵ 
• 
• 3x + 4 = 4 × 105

**Calculations:**

5³x ⁺ ⁴ = 5⁴ × ¹⁰⁵

⇒ 5³x ⁺ ⁴ = 5⁴²⁰

⇒ 3x + 4 = 420

⇒ 3x = 420 − 4

⇒ 3x = 416

⇒ x = 416 ÷ 3

⇒ x = 138.666...

The integral part of a number is the greatest integer less than or equal to that number.

⇒ Integral part of x = 138

**∴ The correct answer is 138.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product and Quotient Laws of Indices

When bases are the same, multiply by adding powers: am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ. Divide by subtracting powers: am ÷ aⁿ = am−ⁿ.

Integral Part (Greatest Integer Function)

The integral part of a real number x, often denoted as [x], is the largest integer that is not greater than x. For example, [138.66] = 138.

Power of a Power Rule

When a base with an exponent is raised to another power, multiply the exponents together: (am)ⁿ = am×ⁿ.

Negative and Zero Indices

Any non-zero base raised to the power of 0 equals 1 (a⁰ = 1). A negative power indicates a reciprocal: a−ⁿ = 1/aⁿ.
